visual_action: A slideshow of historical, black-and-white portraits of male Supreme Court justices transitions to a modern, color photograph of Ketanji Brown Jackson, a Black woman, smiling in her judicial robes.

cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: She is the final person shown in a color photograph, and the on-screen text describes the confirmation of the first Black woman to the Supreme Court.

cast.name: Antonin Scalia
cast.evidence: A black and white portrait of him appears at 0:05 in a montage of past Supreme Court justices.

on_screen_text.text: For the first time in our nation's history...
a Black woman has been confirmed to the Supreme Court

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: An upbeat, dramatic, and building electronic pop track ('Scream & Shout' by will.i.am) plays throughout, creating a sense of momentousness and celebration that culminates with the final image.
editing_pacing: The video is a slideshow of still images, with cuts paced to the beat of the music. It features a montage of quick cuts before holding on the final image.
cultural_references: The video is set to the song 'Scream & Shout' by will.i.am.
central_claim: The confirmation of the first Black woman to the Supreme Court is a historic and celebratory milestone for the United States.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel proud and inspired by this historic achievement.
uncertainty_flags: The specific identities of most of the historical figures in the black-and-white portraits are not confirmed, besides Antonin Scalia.
